content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IGRUA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IGRUA Aircraft Maintenance Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Aircraft Maintenance Engineer positions at IGRUA is 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Aircraft Maintenance Engineers?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Aircraft Maintenance Engineer posts, with one each for Avionics and Mechanical specializations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have Aircraft Maintenance Engineering/Mechanical Engineering or B.Sc Physics or B.Sc Mathematics, along with an AME License in Category B1 and 2 years of aviation experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 55 years, as of 1st June 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Aircraft Maintenance Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 91,000 per month, plus a Transport Allowance of ₹1800 and an Aviation Allowance of ₹300 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for General/OBC or SC/ST category candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IGRUA AME recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. In which city is Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi located?
faq.answer: Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi is located in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 229302.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for contractual positions at Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi.

faq.question: Q10. How should candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply by sending their complete application via email before the specified last date.
